title: Nonnegativity of failure probability
statement: Let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$ be a Boolean function, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\\delta\\in\\mathbb R$ satisfy $0\\le\\delta\\le1$. Then the coordinate-switching failure probability of $f$ at parameter $\\delta$ and threshold $k$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
